classification.scoreJS: function(t){ if(!/Strands/.test(t)) return null; var rows=t.split(/\r?\n/).map(function(l){return l.trim();}).filter(function(l){ return l.length && /^(?:🔵|🟡|💡)+$/.test(l); }); if(!rows.length) return null; var g=rows.join(''); var hints=(g.match(/💡/g)||[]).length; var first=g.match(/🔵|🟡/); var base=hints===0?'No hints':hints+(hints===1?' hint':' hints'); return (first&&first[0]==='🟡')?base+' · Spangram first':base; }

classification.scoreJS: function(t){ var h=t.match(/Association #\d+ \/ (\u274C )?(\d+:\d{2})/); if(!h) return null; if(h[1]) return 'Out of mistakes'; var rows=t.split(/\r?\n/).map(function(l){return l.trim();}).filter(function(l){return /^(?:\uD83D[\uDFE9\uDFE6\uDFEA\uDFE7]){4}$/.test(l);}); var m=0; for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){ var c=rows[i].match(/\uD83D[\uDFE9\uDFE6\uDFEA\uDFE7]/g); if(c[0]!==c[1]||c[0]!==c[2]||c[0]!==c[3]) m++; } return m ? h[2]+' \u00B7 '+m+(m===1?' mistake':' mistakes') : h[2]; }

featured.review: Two words are missing the same three letters. Find the three that fit both. As a line slides down the screen, more words appear as clues, so waiting makes it easier but costs you. See if you can beat the clock.
